metadata.description: Apple iOS profile GET response with Restrictions payload. Literal (not {id}-template) endpoint by design (collision sweep, 2026-08-05): this fixture is a field-decode-shape test double for tests/generated_deviceprofilev2_response_fields_test.go's direct-file-read decode check, not a live-captured canonical answer for GET /api/mdm/profiles/{id} -- profiles_get_apple_id.json is that canonical fixture. A literal endpoint removes this from the {id}-template matching pool entirely (exact-literal-path scoring beats template match per internal/mockserver/matcher.go), same pattern already used for the profiles/appleosx/winrt lifecycle-stage fixtures in this directory.
